# Lalitpur Academy School

SEO-first static website for a Nepal-rooted school in Hattiban, Lalitpur.

## Purpose

Help parents understand the school, explore the Nepal-focused education approach, and request an admissions call for 2026.

## Key facts

- School: Lalitpur Academy School
- Short name: LAS
- Location: Hattiban, Lalitpur, Nepal
- Programs: Early Years, Primary School, Middle School, Secondary School
- Audience: parents and guardians in Lalitpur and Kathmandu Valley

## Important URLs

- Home: https://las.edu.np/
- Admissions: https://las.edu.np/#admissions
- Nepal focus: https://las.edu.np/#nepal
- Programs: https://las.edu.np/#programs
- FAQ: https://las.edu.np/#faq

## Technical notes

- Semantic HTML content is visible in the source.
- Structured data is included with JSON-LD.
- Sass source: src/scss/main.scss
- Compiled CSS: css/main.css
- JavaScript: js/revamp.js
- No jQuery or heavy front-end framework is required.
